title: SSRF in webhook URL fetcher: no host allowlist, follows redirects to internal IPs
description: The webhook delivery code in webhooks/client.py fetches a user-configured URL with requests.get(url, allow_redirects=True) and no validation of the destination host. An attacker can point a webhook at http://169.254.169.254/ or an internal service, and because redirects are followed, even an allowlisted host can 302 to an internal address. send_webhook() should validate the resolved IP and re-validate after each redirect.
poc_text: Set a webhook target of http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ and observe the response body delivered back to the configured sink.
